text:
lee: Quick sync — Safeguard Labs wants to list their HSM-backed KMS in our cloud marketplace. They asked about our onboarding packet and evidence we require for a BYO-KMS flow. Can someone own the technical checklist?
anika: I can lead the security intake. We need: FIPS140-2/3 certs, hardware attestation report (ROCA/firmware), key wrapping algorithms supported, and signing key lifecycle docs. Also need their JWKS endpoint + cert rotation schedule.
rob: Marketplace needs: legal SLA template acceptance, logo + short description, and a packaged deploy guide for customers (1-page). We also require a partner contact and a public support SLA window. Suggested launch target: July 14.
dez: Engineering asks: what protocols do they expose? We prefer KMS over REST with JSON, and an option for PKCS#11 agent. If they provide a provisioning API, share a sample call. Example we expect from them: 
```
POST /v1/keys/provision
Authorization: Bearer <token>
{ "type": "ed25519", "usage": ["sign","verify"] }
```
lee: Also confirm SCIM capabilities — do they support SCIM v2 PATCH and change events? Customers want group sync and 429 backoff semantics documented.
anika: Also request SAML metadata XML if they plan to support SSO for partner admin console. Need entityID, IdP/Sp metadata, and an IdP-initiated login test plan.
rob: I'll prep the partner listing draft and product tile once we have security artifacts. Can someone add a short list of integration risks for our listing notes? (e.g., BYOK UX, cross-account rotation complexity, failover behaviour)
dez: Quick risk bullets: 1) Latency spike during scheduled rotations. 2) SCIM pagination differences causing partial syncs. 3) Unclear error semantics from HSM agent leading to retriable vs permanent failures. 4) Edge case: metadata mismatch on SAML causing fallback loops.
oncall-bot: Incident template generated: https://redwood.in/incidents/template/safeguard-kms-outage — link added to checklist.
lee: Next steps: anika request certs + attestation, dez ask for sample API calls and agent logs, rob set embargo & partner blurb, i'll schedule 20-min sync Fri 9am PT. @safeguard-contacts please upload artifacts to the secure upload before Thu EOD. Thanks :raised_hands:
